Hi Emily — quick technical note to supplement Marissa's attachments.

High-level subprocessor/cloud footprint (production):
- AWS (us-west-2): compute (EC2/GPU instances), S3 for encrypted object storage. We use KMS for key management; customer keys can be integrated via KMS/HSM for Private deployments.
- GCP (us-central1): optional for dedicated/private customers; used for backup replication in select regions.
- Redis/managed KV (AWS ElastiCache): transient KV cache for inference; no long-term storage of prompt content.
- Datadog / Sentry: monitoring and alerting for service health (aggregated telemetry only).
- Third-party model providers: We surface a curated catalog but any external model weights are marked and subject to customer opt-in; no customer prompt data is sent to external model vendors unless explicitly configured.

Data sharing boundaries:
- Customer prompt/content data: encrypted in transit and at rest, access-controlled. We do not share raw prompts with analytics vendors; only aggregate usage metrics are exported.
- Metadata & billing records: contain non-sensitive usage metrics and are stored for billing and SLO monitoring.

SOC 2 timeline: target for Type II delivery is 2027-04-30. We'll provide the artifact over a secure link (DocuSign/secure download) and can execute an NDA if required for the full report.

Point of contact for questionnaire: security@redwood.com (primary), rishi_malhotra@redwood.com (technical follow-ups). Please upload the completed questionnaire to the shared Drive folder or email it directly to the security address.

Let me know if you need a short architecture diagram — I can attach one.

Regards,
